visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An aerial drone shot shows four individuals standing on a paved path amidst a dense, sprawling forest of vibrant pink cherry blossoms on a hillside. The camera pulls back significantly to reveal the immense scale of the blooming trees against the green mountain background. (2) Close-up shots focus on individual pink flower clusters. The scene transitions to a group of people sitting at an outdoor wooden table beneath a large white umbrella; a woman in a white sweater laughs while gesturing toward the food. (3) A blue wooden sign for the 'Mu Xin Quan' farm is shown, decorated with a large red flower; a man and woman stand beside it, smiling at the camera. (4) A hand holds several paper entrance tickets against a blurred garden background. A following shot shows a narrow road leading to a rustic dark wood ticket booth adorned with festive red lanterns. (5) Drone shots follow the group as they walk through elaborate pink and light-pink floral tunnels. A woman in a black and white polka-dot dress is seen climbing wooden stairs flanked by lush green foliage. (6) Rapid cuts show various flora including deep pink blossoms, bright yellow trees lining a path, and a tunnel created by tall green trees. (7) The group of four poses for a commemorative photo on a bench surrounded by cherry blossoms. (8) At the restaurant, a woman holds a white bowl filled with fresh hot pot ingredients before eating. A close-up reveals meat and vegetables sizzling on a flat iron plate. (9) A bright blue bird is perched on a power line. The video concludes with sweeping aerial vistas of the flowering landscape and text overlays for engagement.
